intelligence.human_view: Think of each slide as a room with a door. A door with no sign on it makes you guess what is behind it — and guessing is not design. So every slide gets its name at the top and a plain explanation of what it does, and Your Worlds gets all six worlds in one row, each in its own little raised board, each with its label, a third of the size they were, so you can see them all and just go into one. The News slide tells you it is the news hub, and each door carries a count of new stories, so you can see at a glance where the news is. Behind every day sits its own real picture — purple Sunday, orange Monday, gold Tuesday, blue Wednesday, green Thursday, red Friday, indigo Saturday — the mood of the day changing as the days change. Booking stops showing you a long list of empty slots that looks like nothing is booked, and instead gives you one centred button — "Book a time" — that opens a little calendar of where the time actually is, with fifteen-minute and half-hour choices. And before anyone builds the best booking system in the universe, they study the best booking systems in the world — elite is studied, not guessed. The avatar's movement is still waiting on the platform, so the honest answer is the check itself — and the one photo that worked before is the one to try again, because his memory of what worked beats a fresh guess. On Messenger, the topic pills just say the topic's name, and the lit pill glows around its back, never washed over its face.
intelligence.simple_view: Every slide gets a name and tells you what it does! Your Worlds shows all six worlds in ONE row, each with its own label, small enough to all fit! The News slide tells you it is the news hub, with a count of new stories on each door! Each day has its own picture behind it — purple Sunday, orange Monday, gold Tuesday, blue Wednesday, green Thursday, red Friday, indigo Saturday! Booking is one big button in the middle — "Book a time" — and it opens a little calendar! Before we build the best booking system ever, we study the best ones in the world! The avatar is still waiting for its movement to come back! And the topic pills just say the name — no numbers on them!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — every slide gets its name at the top, dear, and tells you plainly what it does, so you never have to guess! Your Worlds shows all six worlds in one row, love, each in its own little raised board, each with its label, small enough that they all fit nicely! The News slide tells you it is the news hub, dear, and each door carries a count of new stories, so you can see where the news is at a glance! Behind every day sits its own real picture, love — purple Sunday, orange Monday, gold Tuesday, blue Wednesday, green Thursday, red Friday, indigo Saturday — the mood changing with the day! Booking is one big button in the middle, dear — "Book a time" — and it opens a little calendar of where the time is! And before anyone builds the best booking system in the world, love, they study the best ones first!
intelligence.naya_view: Thoughtful follow-through is the standing style: every delivery arrives checked — recommend, love, don't love, suggest, why — never "here, check it." Your Worlds: six icons, one row, own elevated boards, labels ON, about a third the size; click carries the day filter. Every slide: title + explanation; News labelled as the hub, smaller icons, live new-story counts on each door. Backgrounds: seven real covers, one per day in the day's colour, behind the content inside the frame, never behind wisdom; Monday keeps the palace hall for now; Wednesday resized to 1920×640; Thursday filename corrected on filing; no invented covers, no placeholders — dispatch holds until his covers arrive. Booking: no slot list — drop-down, closed until clicked, 15/30-minute options, "Book a time" centred, click opens a mini calendar; same headliner as the rest. Elite: study the best booking systems in the world first, then build to that standard; the walk closes on his word — thirteen items, the brief is the brief. Avatar: motion checked 13:50 MST, still none, video_available false, no blind retries; the photo that worked before gets the retry — four candidates, awaiting his pick, motion judged only after activation. Messenger: pills carry the topic name only, no "online" counts; active pill's glow around the back, never over the top.
